from pathlib import Path

old = '''def pipe_sockets(a: socket.socket, b: socket.socket) -> None:\n    done = threading.Event()\n\n    def copy(src: socket.socket, dst: socket.socket) -> None:\n        try:\n            while not done.is_set():\n                data = src.recv(65536)\n                if not data:\n                    break\n                dst.sendall(data)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        finally:\n            done.set()\n            try:\n                dst.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            try:\n                src.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RD)\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n\n    t1 = threading.Thread(target=copy, args=(a, b), daemon=True)\n    t2 = threading.Thread(target=copy, args=(b, a), daemon=True)\n    t1.start(); t2.start()\n    while not done.is_set():\n        time.sleep(0.01)\n    # Give the opposite direction a brief chance to flush EOF.\n    t1.join(timeout=1)\n    t2.join(timeout=1)\n    try:\n        a.close()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    try:\n        b.close()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n'''

When one direction reaches EOF we\n    # half-close the opposite socket, but we still allow bytes already flowing\n    # in the other direction to be delivered (important for protocols whose\n    # clients use shutdown(SHUT_WR) before reading a reply).\n    def copy(src: socket.socket, dst: socket.socket) -> None:\n        try:\n            while True:\n                data = src.recv(65536)\n                if not data:\n                    break\n                dst.sendall(data)\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        finally:\n            try:\n                dst.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR)\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n\n    t1 = threading.Thread(target=copy, args=(a, b), daemon=True)\n    t2 = threading.Thread(target=copy, args=(b, a), daemon=True)\n    t1.start(); t2.start()\n    while t1.is_alive() or t2.is_alive():\n        t1.join(timeout=0.1)\n        t2.join(timeout=0.1)\n    try:\n        a.close()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    try:\n        b.close()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n'''
